```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)

# Renaming size column
Spleen_sizes <- Spleen_sizes %>% mutate(size = `Size of mass (if applicable)`)

# Function to extract numbers and compute areas, treating single numbers as squares
extract_largest_area <- function(text) {
  if(is.na(text)) return(NA_real_)
  
  # Extract all "number x number" patterns
  matches <- str_extract_all(text, "(\\d+\\.?\\d*)\\s*[xX]\\s*(\\d+\\.?\\d*)")[[1]]
  
  # Extract standalone numbers (like "6cm", "12.5") that are not part of "x"
  single_numbers <- str_extract_all(text, "(?<![xX\\d])\\d+\\.?\\d*(?![xX\\d])")[[1]]
  
  # Convert "x" patterns to numeric areas
  areas <- map_dbl(matches, function(m) {
    nums <- as.numeric(str_split(m, "[xX]")[[1]])
    prod(nums)
  })
  
  # Convert single numbers to squares
  single_areas <- as.numeric(single_numbers)^2
  
  # Combine and return the largest
  all_areas <- c(areas, single_areas)
  
  if(length(all_areas) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  
  max(all_areas, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Apply function to your column
Spleen_sizes <- Spleen_sizes %>%
  mutate(largest_nodule_area = map_dbl(size, extract_largest_area))
```

```{r}
# New try
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Function to extract largest nodule area
extract_largest_area <- function(text){
  # Skip if NA
  if(is.na(text)) return(NA)
  
  # Extract all "number x number" patterns (handles decimals)
  matches <- str_extract_all(text, "(\\d+\\.?\\d*)\\s*[xX]\\s*(\\d+\\.?\\d*)")[[1]]
  
  if(length(matches) > 0){
    # Compute area for each match
    areas <- sapply(matches, function(m){
      nums <- as.numeric(unlist(str_split(m, "[xX]")))
      prod(nums)
    })
    return(max(areas))
  }
  
  # If no "x" patterns, extract single numbers and square them
  single_nums <- str_extract_all(text, "\\d+\\.?\\d*")[[1]]
  if(length(single_nums) > 0){
    single_nums <- as.numeric(single_nums)
    return(max(single_nums^2))
  }
  
  return(NA)
}

# Apply function safely to create a new column
Spleen_sizes <- Spleen_sizes %>%
  mutate(largest_area = sapply(size, extract_largest_area))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)

extract_largest_area <- function(text) {
  # Handle NA or empty strings
  if(is.na(text) || str_trim(text) == "") return(NA_real_)
  
  text <- tolower(text)
  
  # Extract "length x width" patterns
  matches <- str_extract_all(text, "(\\d+\\.?\\d*)\\s*[x]\\s*(\\d+\\.?\\d*)")[[1]]
  
  areas <- numeric(0)
  
  if(length(matches) > 0){
    areas <- sapply(matches, function(m) {
      dims <- as.numeric(unlist(str_split(m, "[x]")))
      if(length(dims) == 2) prod(dims) else NA_real_
    })
  }
  
  # Remove "x" patterns from text so we don't double-count numbers
  text_no_x <- text
  if(length(matches) > 0){
    for(m in matches){
      text_no_x <- str_replace_all(text_no_x, fixed(m), "")
    }
  }
  
  # Extract standalone numbers (assume square)
  single_numbers <- str_extract_all(text_no_x, "\\d+\\.?\\d*")[[1]]
  if(length(single_numbers) > 0){
    single_areas <- as.numeric(single_numbers)^2
    areas <- c(areas, single_areas)
  }
  
  # Ensure numeric output
  areas <- as.numeric(areas)
  
  if(length(areas) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  
  max(areas, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Apply function safely
Spleen_sizes <- Spleen_sizes %>%
  mutate(largest_area = map_dbl(size, extract_largest_area))

# Check first 30
data.frame(
  original = Spleen_sizes$size[1:30],
  largest_area = Spleen_sizes$largest_area[1:30]
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

SizeGroups <- Spleen_sizes %>%
  mutate(size_group = cut(
    largest_area,
    breaks = c(0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300, Inf),  # adjust bins as needed
    labels = c("0-50","50-100","100-150","150-200","200-250","250-300","300+"),
    include.lowest = TRUE
  ))
```

```{r}
ggplot(SizeGroups %>% filter(!is.na(size_group) & !is.na(rupture)),
       aes(x = size_group, fill = rupture)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +  # side-by-side bars
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("no" = "lightblue", "yes" = "salmon")) +
  labs(
    title = "Mass Size Distribution by Rupture Status",
    x = "Size Group",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Rupture"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
